correctness.rationale: From the original model demographic balance, both cross-entries equal their patch reproduction number times the same S divided by local population. For the simple Perron eigenvalue, implicit differentiation gives strict risky-commuter monotonicity; any stationary safe-commuter point has strictly positive second derivative. The witness quadratic is exact and the smaller eigenvalue is always below one. Exact rational checks and 200 additional instances replay successfully; finite checks are not relied on as proof.

value.rationale: The model-specific optimum allocation of residents versus commuters is an epidemiologically motivated intervention problem. Proving the unique optimum without fast mixing resolves a material timescale limitation; the exact safe allocation interval demonstrates a genuinely important distinction between avoiding and permitting initial epidemic growth when both extreme policies fail.
